description: AICTIONBOT™ data X-ray by KULIC Advisory, built on the Execution Toolkit template T24 (self data audit). Takes any list (one row per record) and returns per column the fill rate, the detected type (email, IBAN with checksum, VAT ID, date, phone, number, text), invalid values with examples, spelling variants and stray spaces, numeric outliers and whether it probably holds personal data; for the list the key column with its duplicates, exact duplicate rows and a score from 1 to 5 for completeness, validity, uniqueness and consistency (below 3 means clean up before automation or AI). For vendor lists check_vendor_master adds IBAN, VAT ID and risk signals. Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored. Needs sign-in: runs with an AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence; without a licence one check per connection every 30 days is free (sign in with “Connect without a licence”).

key.description: Column that should be unique (e.g. supplier number). Default: detected.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

rows.description: The list, one object per row, column names as keys.

name: audit_list
title: Data X-ray for any list: fill rate per column, formats (email, IBAN, VAT ID, date, number), duplicates, spelling variants, outliers, personal data
